reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness diagnostic plugin that analyzes existing session event logs, detects failure patterns, and produces redacted postmortem reports with optional explanatory model review.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读故障复盘插件，可从既有会话事件日志生成脱敏报告、导出 JSON 并提供仅可复制的修复提示。
summaries.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that analyzes existing session event logs to produce redacted postmortem reports, JSON exports, and copy-only repair prompts.

capabilities: Reads existing DeepSeek Harness session event logs
Detects specified failure patterns with local rules
Optionally sends up to four redacted findings to the configured DSH language model for explanatory review
